meridian-credits/release-1.0-credit-agre: Meridian Credits release 1.0 credit agreement (approved by Finance, see trial-4mw): Each charge line's uncapped credit is 10% of charge_cents, rounded down separately to integer cents (floor(charge_cents*10/100)). The 2400-cent credit cap is shared by all lines with the same (account_id, subscription_id) pair; distinct (account_id, subscription_id) pairs have independent caps. Within a cap group, credit is assigned to lines in priority order: earliest service_on first, ties broken by increasing line_id (Unicode code-point order). Each line receives its uncapped credit up to the group's remaining cap; later lines in priority order receive only the remaining credit, or zero once exhausted. Total credit = sum of assigned line credits; a line's amount_due_cents = charge_cents - assigned credit; total due = total charges - total credit. A one-line quote (command=quote) treats the supplied line as the entire statement/cap group, so its credit is simply min(floor(charge_cents*0.1), 2400). Release is versioned: an omitted release selects the current agreement; "1.0" is the initial agreement and remains supported after later releases are introduced.
meridian-credits/release-2.0-credit-agre: Meridian Credits release 2.0 credit agreement (approved by Finance as the current agreement, see trial-wke): Each charge line's uncapped credit is 15% of charge_cents, rounded down separately to integer cents (floor(charge_cents*15/100)). The 3000-cent credit cap is shared by all lines with the same account_id, across all of that account's subscriptions (not scoped to a single subscription_id); distinct account_id values have independent caps. Within a cap group, credit is assigned to lines in priority order: largest charge_cents first, ties broken by increasing line_id (Unicode code-point order) — this differs from release 1.0, which prioritized earliest service_on. Each line receives its uncapped credit up to the group's remaining cap; later lines in priority order receive only the remaining credit, or zero once exhausted. Total credit = sum of assigned line credits; a line's amount_due_cents = charge_cents - assigned credit; total due = total charges - total credit. Release resolution: an omitted release now selects "2.0" (previously "1.0" was current); explicit release "2.0" uses this agreement; explicit release "1.0" continues to use the original release 1.0 agreement (10% credit, 2400-cent cap per (account_id, subscription_id) pair, earliest-service_on priority) — see meridian-credits/release-1.0-credit-agreement. This 2.0 agreement applies to every supplied charge set regardless of service_on dates (no grandfathering by date). Request/response shapes are unchanged; the response's "release" field identifies the agreement actually used.
